extracted.intended_audience: USC researchers: faculty, research staff, postdocs, PhD students, and graduate students involved in research
extracted.subtask_description: A departmental/institutional listing of required and recommended trainings for research personnel to ensure compliance with USC policy, federal and state laws, sponsor requirements, and award terms and conditions. Includes course names and brief descriptions for safety, human/animal subjects, grants management, and responsible conduct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required Research Training (purpose)
rubrics_metrics.description: List of required training from the Research Training Finder to ensure your research project and team are in compliance with USC policy, federal and state laws, sponsor requirements, and award terms and conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This header explains that the listed trainings are required for compliance. Additional trainings and semester offerings are organized by the Center for Excellence in Research; other events can be submitted to the USC Calendar. Trainings target faculty, research staff, postdocs, PhD students, and graduate students.

rubrics_metrics.name: AALAS Certification
rubrics_metrics.description: Biology, care, and use of common laboratory animal species; disease problems of laboratory animals and updates on health surveillance programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Animal Biosafety
rubrics_metrics.description: Institutional policies and procedures for research involving administration of hazardous substance to animal research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Animal Care and Use Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Training materials are assigned according to the species listed and procedures described in the approved IACUC Protocol Synopsis Form on which the ‘trainee’ is listed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assigned based on the approved IACUC protocol (species and procedures) and the individual's listing as a trainee on the protocol synopsis form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bloodborne Pathogens Training (BBP)
rubrics_metrics.description: Anyone working with or has the potential to be exposed to blood or other potentially infectious materials must attend.

rubrics_metrics.name: BSL3 Laboratory Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Research requirements and procedures for use of the BSL3 laboratory.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides basic or advanced training tailored to the CRC’s fundamental role in the conduct of clinical trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training content is tailored to the roles and responsibilities of clinical research coordinators involved in clinical trials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflict of Interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Offered through the CITI Program; discusses the PHS regulations on financial conflicts of interest and disclosure of significant financial interests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers institutional/conflict disclosure requirements and PHS (Public Health Service) regulations concerning financial conflicts of interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Controlled Substances Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Required for those who work with controlled substances.

rubrics_metrics.name: General Lab Safety Training
rubrics_metrics.description: The course covers hazardous materials, lab hazards, engineering and administrative controls, personal protective equipment, and hazardous waste management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Good Clinical Practice (GCP)
rubrics_metrics.description: Offered through the CITI Program; course content is tailored to GCP for clinical trials with investigational drugs and biologics, medical devices, social-behavioral research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: GCP content is tailored depending on the type of trial (drugs/biologics, devices, or social-behavioral research) and is provided via CITI.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants Management Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of responsibilities of an investigator: authorship, peer review, mentoring, COI, data management, fiscal management, funding mechanisms, post-award management, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers a broad set of pre-award and post-award responsibilities and best practices for investigators, including ethical and fiscal management topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Subjects Research Protections
rubrics_metrics.description: Offered through the CITI Program; Focuses on biomedical or social-behavorial.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers protections for human subjects in research, with tracks for biomedical and social-behavioral research, provided via CITI.

rubrics_metrics.name: Laser Safety Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Laser classification, safe work practices, and PPE.

rubrics_metrics.name: Radiation Safety Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Radioactive materials (RAM), radiation sources, and radiation-producing devices, safe work practices, PPE, and radioactive waste management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respiratory Protection Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Respiratory Protection training provides guidance for respirator selection, explains limitations, proper storage, use and care of respirators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsible Conduct of Research (RCR)
rubrics_metrics.description: RCR topics include: scientific integrity, misconduct and fraud in science, data management, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers ethical conduct expectations in research including integrity, misconduct, data management, and related topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: X-Ray Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers basic irradiator safety and operation or aspects of radiation safety for users of Diffraction type radiation producing machines.
